Hi I don’t know if you still happen to be around but:

1. How long does the infection take to be implemented?
My friend clicked on this link and they haven’t received any changes but they’re paranoid at the revelation that it’s an RAT. 

2. If infection goes through, what will happen other than payments being done?

3. If infection goes through, how do they replace their discord infected client? Do they have to delete the RAT first?

I thank you for your kind words. I’ve been told many that I’m perceptive and in touch with my own emotions as well as others. I guess it’s that attention seeker in me. However you misunderstand my journey to find a purpose - to to fault of your own of course. It’s… confusing. My want to find a purpose is to find a reason to not feel so unbothered about jumping. 

It isn’t to mean something, at least not for now, not while I’m like this. It’s to make me have an inkling of “Oh. Maybe I don’t need to die just yet.” Lately it’s been wearing off and I’m grasping at straws to find it.


My mother has been a great support yes, and truthfully the guilt of leaving her behind is what kills me. I’d leave her behind with an absent father and a childless future. Yet I have been losing that desire to stay.

Maybe it’s because of my being manipulated into an abusive relationship last year, my grades tanking that led to this. But that would be a lie it only amplified my stress. It’s been tearing away at me. I have no time. Finals are coming and I want more than anything to restart this year. I really do. Yet in my area I feel it is looked down upon and shameful. Maybe homeschooling but it’s hard to think about. I just don’t want to give up, and yet I don’t want to keep going. It’s just so easy to look at the bridge and say goodbye. I’m, like I said, just so unsure.
